engine.description: Only list checks from this answer engine, for example 'claude-web-search'.

include_answer_text.description: Set to false to return answer_text as null on every check. Use it to page through history without the engines' answers.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

since.description: Only list checks that ran at or after this time, in ISO 8601 (for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

version.description: Only list checks that ran this version of the prompt.
